title: The Night That Lasted A Lifetime

sentences.en: From NPR, this is Hidden Brain.
sentences.zh: 这里是NPR，欢迎收听《隐藏的大脑》。

sentences.en: On the night of the murder, there's bad weather in Boston.
sentences.zh: 谋杀案发生的当晚，波士顿天气恶劣。

sentences.en: It was a rainy night, and I went back to the foster home.
sentences.zh: 那是一个雨夜，我回到了寄养家庭。

sentences.en: Fred Clay knocks on his foster mother's door.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德·克莱敲响了寄养母亲的房门。

sentences.en: Fred has been away for a few days, visiting his cousins and mother in a neighborhood known as Roslindale.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德离家几天，去罗斯林代尔探望了他的表亲和母亲。

sentences.en: He knows he is probably in trouble with his foster mother.
sentences.zh: 他知道自己可能惹寄养母亲生气了。

sentences.en: He hadn't told her he was taking off.
sentences.zh: 他没告诉她自己要出门。

sentences.en: I just went out and didn't come back for a few days.
sentences.zh: 我只是出门了，几天没回来而已。

sentences.en: He let me in the house, and he was telling me that his mother wanted to talk to me about me not being there for the last few days.
sentences.zh: 他让我进了屋，并告诉我，他母亲想找我谈谈我这几天没在家的事情。

sentences.en: Thankfully for Fred, his foster mother isn't home.
sentences.zh: 幸运的是，弗雷德的寄养母亲不在家。

sentences.en: And so he let me in, and I went back to my room.
sentences.zh: 于是他让我进了屋，我便回到了自己的房间。

sentences.en: I watched a load of TV.
I got something to eat, and I eventually fell asleep.
sentences.zh: 我吃了点东西，最后睡着了。

sentences.en: Around 9.30, as Fred sleeps, his foster mother returns home.
sentences.zh: 大约9点半，弗雷德在睡梦中时，他的寄养母亲回到了家。

sentences.en: She locks the front door from the inside, so none of the kids in the house can leave overnight.
sentences.zh: 她从里面锁上了前门，这样屋里的孩子们晚上就出不去了。

sentences.en: She's the only one with the key.
So I was in that room all that time, sleeping.
sentences.zh: 所以我一直待在那个房间里睡觉。

sentences.en: I didn't know the door was locked.
sentences.zh: 我根本不知道门被锁上了。

sentences.en: I didn't even know the murder was happening.
sentences.zh: 我甚至不知道谋杀案正在发生。

sentences.en: Late that night, a man will be shot to death in Roslindale.
sentences.zh: 那天深夜，一名男子在罗斯林代尔被枪杀。

sentences.en: Asleep in his bed, three weeks past his 16th birthday, Fred doesn't know it, but a boulder is rolling down a hill toward him.
sentences.zh: 弗雷德刚过完16岁生日三周，当时正躺在床上熟睡，他并不知道，一块巨石正向他滚来。

sentences.en: In a matter of days, it will make his life unrecognizable.
sentences.zh: 没过几天，他的生活就变得面目全非。

sentences.en: He's going to be arrested for the murder.
sentences.zh: 他将因这起谋杀案被捕。

sentences.en: Various ideas in psychology will be used to decide that he is guilty.
sentences.zh: 心理学中的各种观点将被用来判定他有罪。

sentences.en: This week on Hidden Brain, we go back four decades to retrace the steps of Fred Clay's arrest and prosecution.
sentences.zh: 本周的《隐藏的大脑》，我们将回到四十年前，重溯弗雷德·克莱被捕和起诉的过程。

sentences.en: And we'll uncover the harm that arises when flawed ideas from psychology are used to determine that a teenager should spend the rest of his life behind bars.
sentences.zh: 我们将揭露当心理学中的错误观点被用来判定一名青少年应在铁窗后度过余生时，所造成的伤害。

sentences.en: Several hours after Fred Clay returns to his foster home, cab driver Richard Dwyer is sitting in his taxi.
sentences.zh: 在弗雷德·克莱回到寄养家庭几个小时后，出租车司机理查德·德怀尔正坐在他的车里。

sentences.en: He's parked in downtown Boston's red light district, better known as the Combat Zone.
sentences.zh: 他停在波士顿市中心的红灯区，也就是人们熟知的“战斗区”。

sentences.en: It's late, but the street is lit by the neon lights of a theater and nearby pizza shop.
sentences.zh: 时间很晚了，但街道被剧院和附近披萨店的霓虹灯照亮。
